d:
Kudiyan Lahore Diyan, now in 8K. Harrdy Sandhu and Aisha Sharma bring a Punjabi pop track with Jaani and Arvvindr S Khaira as producers, and a video directed by Arvvindr S Khaira.
Watch it in full 8K and turn it up.
Singer: Harrdy Sandhu
Featuring: Aisha Sharma
Music and Composition: B Praak
Lyrics: Jaani
Producers: Jaani, Arvvindr S Khaira
Director: Arvvindr S Khaira
